note: One look per UTC day (reels/PLAYBOOK.md, 'The look of the day'). 'days' is the log, newest last. 'ready' lists looks made but not used yet.

days.name: Leonida Sunset
days.mood: Golden hour on the Keys: amber-to-pink gradients, chrome titles, light leaking into the lens, whip pans.
new_code: the look engine (reels/src/looks: types, state, registry; reels.style in plan.json)
top bars: tape, case, ticker, minimal
finishes: vhs, halftone, paper, lightleak, dust, crt, bloom
cuts: flash, shutter, whip, glitch, iris, ink; scene entries: slide, rise, snap

days.name: Vice Tape
days.mood: A 1986 camcorder tape found in a Vice City pawn shop: neon on black, tracking lines, a tape counter, closed captions.
new_code: captions: cc (1980s closed captions: white mono on black bars, accent word with a blinking block cursor)
cuts: tracking (a VHS tracking roll: static band rolls up the frame with a head-switch bar)

days.name: Leonida Herald
days.mood: A trashy Florida tabloid's front page: gameplay printed as two-tone newsprint, ransom-note captions cut letter by letter from other pages, red ink, a newspaper page turning over every cut.
new_code: captions: ransom (each letter cut from a different page: its own font, paper colour, tilt and torn edge; the spoken word lifts off on the accent paper)
cuts: pageturn (a newsprint page with a masthead, headline bars, a photo box and columns sweeps in with a curled edge, covers the cut and leaves left)

days.name: Evidence Locker
days.mood: A detective's case file on Leonida's strangest secrets: sepia gameplay, words punched on label-maker tape, a flashbulb and a numbered evidence marker on every cut.
new_code: captions: dymo (each word punched in raised white letters on its own strip of glossy label-maker tape with notched ends; the spoken word sits on accent tape and lifts)
cuts: marker (a flashbulb pops over the cut while a numbered yellow evidence tent slides up; Reel.tsx now passes each cut its number)
